summary: Resolved all three pre-existing documentation gaps flagged by QA and Reviewer:
1. api-surface.md progress_snapshot row: added run_start_ts (optional) to key-fields column, with note that it echoes WorkflowState.run_start_ts and is None when unavailable.
2. api-surface.md and jsonl-log-schema.md run_start rows: added plan field (resolved plan file path from cli.py:451 str(plan_path) emission).
3. jsonl-log-schema.md Full Field Reference: added plan field row between dry_run and run_start_ts.

4. jsonl-log-schema.md Action Values table: added three missing supervisor events — safety_limit (iteration safety ceiling exceeded), mcp_error (MCP tool call failure; two variants: ERROR to END, WARNING to PM), halted_repeated_failure (WP halted after 3 consecutive failures) — bringing enumerated count to 16, matching the claimed total in both files.

comments.note: jsonl-log-schema.md Action Values table now enumerates all 16 event types. The mcp_error entry documents both destination variants (END on hard failure, PM on soft warning) and both level values in one row — consistent with the row-per-action-name convention used elsewhere in the table.
